pull.title: KAFKA-15606: Clarify completed fetch error handling tests
pull.body: Clarify when the consumer returns buffered records before reporting a fetch error, removes an empty error response, and retains an incomplete response. Assert the affected partitions and positions explicitly in both consumer implementations, including the seek-before-error case.

commit.message:
KAFKA-15606: Clarify completed fetch error handling tests

Assert returned partitions, fetch positions, and buffered partitions explicitly
in both consumer test suites. Replace manual exception collection with
assertThrows and clarify why errors are deferred until buffered records return.
